verses.en: And they continued three years without war between Syria and Israel.
verses.pt: Três anos passaram sem guerra entre os sírios e Israel.
verses.en_web: They continued three years without war between Syria and Israel.
verses.en_bbe: Now for three years there was no war between Aram and Israel.

verses.en: And it came to pass in the third year, that Jehoshaphat the king of Judah came down to the king of Israel.
verses.pt: E aconteceu ao terceiro ano, que Josafá rei de Judá desceu ao rei de Israel.
verses.en_web: In the third year, Jehoshaphat the king of Judah came down to the king of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: And it came about in the third year, that Jehoshaphat, king of Judah, came down to the king of Israel.

verses.en: And the king of Israel said unto his servants, Know ye that Ramoth in Gilead is ours, and we be still, and take it not out of the hand of the king of Syria?
verses.pt: E o rei de Israel disse a seus servos: Não sabeis que Ramote de Gileade e nossa? Porém ficamos quietos, sem a tomar da mão do rei da Síria.
verses.en_web: The king of Israel said to his servants, “You know that Ramoth Gilead is ours, and we do nothing, and don’t take it out of the hand of the king of Syria?”
verses.en_bbe: And the king of Israel said to his servants, Do you not see that Ramoth-gilead is ours? and we are doing nothing to get it back from the hands of the king of Aram.

verses.en: And he said unto Jehoshaphat, Wilt thou go with me to battle to Ramoth-gilead? And Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, I am as thou art, my people as thy people, my horses as thy horses.
verses.pt: E disse a Josafá: Queres vir comigo a lutar contra Ramote de Gileade? E Josafá respondeu ao rei de Israel: Como eu, assim tu; e como meu povo, assim teu povo; e como meus cavalos, teus cavalos.
verses.en_web: He said to Jehoshaphat, “Will you go with me to battle to Ramoth Gilead?” Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, “I am as you are, my people as your people, my horses as your horses.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said to Jehoshaphat, Will you go with me to Ramoth-gilead to make war? And Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, I am as you are: my people as your people, my horses as your horses.

verses.en: And Jehoshaphat said unto the king of Israel, Enquire, I pray thee, at the word of the LORD to day.
verses.pt: E disse logo Josafá ao rei de Israel: Eu te rogo que consultes hoje a palavra do SENHOR.
verses.en_web: Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, “Please inquire first for Yahweh’s word.”
verses.en_bbe: Then Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, Let us now get directions from the Lord.

verses.en: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together, about four hundred men, and said unto them, Shall I go against Ramoth-gilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And they said, Go up; for the Lord shall deliver it into the hand of the king.
verses.pt: Então o rei de Israel juntou os profetas, como quatrocentos homens, aos quais disse: Irei à guerra contra Ramote de Gileade, ou a deixarei? E eles disseram: Sobe; porque o Senhor a entregará em mão do rei.
verses.en_web: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together, about four hundred men, and said to them, “Should I go against Ramoth Gilead to battle, or should I refrain?” They said, “Go up; for the Lord will deliver it into the hand of the king.”
verses.en_bbe: So the king of Israel got all the prophets together, about four hundred men, and said to them, Am I to go to Ramoth-gilead to make war or not? And they said, Go up: for the Lord will give it into the hands of the king.

verses.en: And Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of the LORD besides, that we might enquire of him?
verses.pt: E disse Josafá: Há ainda aqui algum profeta do SENHOR, pelo qual consultemos?
verses.en_web: But Jehoshaphat said, “Isn’t there here a prophet of Yahweh, that we may inquire of him?”
verses.en_bbe: But Jehoshaphat said, Is there no other prophet of the Lord here from whom we may get directions?

verses.en: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, There is yet one man, Micaiah the son of Imlah, by whom we may enquire of the LORD: but I hate him; for he doth not prophesy good concerning me, but evil. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.
verses.pt: E o rei de Israel respondeu a Josafá: Ainda há um homem pelo qual poderíamos consultar ao SENHOR, Micaías, filho de Inlá: mas eu lhe aborreço porque nunca me profetiza bem, a não ser somente mal. E Josafá disse: Não fale o rei assim.
verses.en_web: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “There is yet one man by whom we may inquire of Yahweh, Micaiah the son of Imlah; but I hate him, for he does not prophesy good concerning me, but evil.” Jehoshaphat said, “Don’t let the king say so.”
verses.en_bbe: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, There is still one man by whom we may get directions from the Lord, Micaiah, son of Imlah; but I have no love for him, for he is a prophet of evil to me and not of good. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.

verses.en: Then the king of Israel called an officer, and said, Hasten hither Micaiah the son of Imlah.
verses.pt: Então o rei de Israel chamou a um eunuco, e disse-lhe: traze logo a Micaías filho de Inlá.
verses.en_web: Then the king of Israel called an officer, and said, “Quickly get Micaiah the son of Imlah.”
verses.en_bbe: Then the king of Israel sent for one of his unsexed servants and said, Go quickly and come back with Micaiah, the son of Imlah.

verses.en: And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah sat each on his throne, having put on their robes, in a void place in the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets prophesied before them.
verses.pt: E o rei de Israel e Josafá rei de Judá estavam sentados cada um em sua cadeira, vestidos de suas roupas reais, na praça junto à entrada da porta de Samaria; e todos os profetas profetizavam diante deles.
verses.en_web: Now the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah were sitting each on his throne, arrayed in their robes, in an open place at the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets were prophesying before them.
verses.en_bbe: Now the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat, the king of Judah, were seated on their seats of authority, dressed in their robes, by the doorway into Samaria; and all the prophets were acting as prophets before them.

verses.en: And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made him horns of iron: and he said, Thus saith the LORD, With these shalt thou push the Syrians, until thou have consumed them.
verses.pt: E Zedequias filho de Quenaaná se havia feito uns chifres de ferro, e disse: Assim disse o SENHOR: Com estes chifrarás aos siros até acabá-los.
verses.en_web: Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made himself horns of iron, and said, “Yahweh says, ‘With these you will push the Syrians, until they are consumed.’”
verses.en_bbe: And Zedekiah, the son of Chenaanah, made himself horns of iron and said, The Lord says, Pushing back the Aramaeans with these, you will put an end to them completely.

verses.en: And all the prophets prophesied so, saying, Go up to Ramoth-gilead, and prosper: for the LORD shall deliver it into the king’s hand.
verses.pt: E todos os profetas profetizavam da mesma maneira, dizendo: Sobe a Ramote de Gileade, e serás próspero; que o SENHOR a dará em mão do rei.
verses.en_web: All the prophets prophesied so, saying, “Go up to Ramoth Gilead, and prosper; for Yahweh will deliver it into the hand of the king.”
verses.en_bbe: And all the prophets said the same thing, saying, Go up to Ramoth-gilead, and it will go well for you, for the Lord will give it into the hands of the king.

verses.en: And the messenger that was gone to call Micaiah spake unto him, saying, Behold now, the words of the prophets declare good unto the king with one mouth: let thy word, I pray thee, be like the word of one of them, and speak that which is good.
verses.pt: E o mensageiro que havia ido a chamar a Micaías, falou-lhe, dizendo: Eis que as palavras dos profetas unanimemente anunciam o bem ao rei; seja agora a tua palavra conforme à palavra de algum deles, e anuncia o bem.
verses.en_web: The messenger who went to call Micaiah spoke to him, saying, “See now, the prophets declare good to the king with one mouth. Please let your word be like the word of one of them, and speak good.”
verses.en_bbe: Now the servant who had gone to get Micaiah said to him, See now, all the prophets with one voice are saying good things to the king; so let your words be like theirs and say good things.

verses.en: And Micaiah said, As the LORD liveth, what the LORD saith unto me, that will I speak.
verses.pt: E Micaías respondeu: Vive o SENHOR, que o que o SENHOR me falar, isso direi.
verses.en_web: Micaiah said, “As Yahweh lives, what Yahweh says to me, that I will speak.”
verses.en_bbe: And Micaiah said, By the living Lord, whatever the Lord says to me I will say.

verses.en: So he came to the king. And the king said unto him, Micaiah, shall we go against Ramoth-gilead to battle, or shall we forbear? And he answered him, Go, and prosper: for the LORD shall deliver it into the hand of the king.
verses.pt: Veio, pois, ao rei, e o rei lhe disse: Micaías, devemos ir lutar por Ramote de Gileade, ou a deixaremos? E ele respondeu: Sobe, que serás próspero, e o SENHOR a entregará na mão do rei.
verses.en_web: When he had come to the king, the king said to him, “Micaiah, shall we go to Ramoth Gilead to battle, or shall we forbear?” He answered him, “Go up and prosper; and Yahweh will deliver it into the hand of the king.”
verses.en_bbe: When he came to the king, the king said to him, Micaiah, are we to go to Ramoth-gilead to make war or not? And in answer he said, Go up, and it will go well for you; and the Lord will give it into the hands of the king.

verses.en: And the king said unto him, How many times shall I adjure thee that thou tell me nothing but that which is true in the name of the LORD?
verses.pt: E o rei lhe disse: Até quantas vezes te farei jurar que não me digas a não ser a verdade no nome do SENHOR?
verses.en_web: The king said to him, “How many times do I have to adjure you that you speak to me nothing but the truth in Yahweh’s name?”
verses.en_bbe: Then the king said to him, Have I not, again and again, put you on your oath to say nothing to me but what is true in the name of the Lord?

verses.en: And he said, I saw all Israel scattered upon the hills, as sheep that have not a shepherd: and the LORD said, These have no master: let them return every man to his house in peace.
verses.pt: Então ele disse: Eu vi a todo Israel disperso pelos montes, como ovelhas que não têm pastor: e o SENHOR disse: Estes não têm senhor: volte-se cada um a sua casa em paz.
verses.en_web: He said, “I saw all Israel scattered on the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd. Yahweh said, ‘These have no master. Let them each return to his house in peace.’”
verses.en_bbe: Then he said, I saw all Israel wandering on the mountains like sheep without a keeper; and the Lord said, These have no master: let them go back, every man to his house in peace.

verses.en: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, Did I not tell thee that he would prophesy no good concerning me, but evil?
verses.pt: E o rei de Israel disse a Josafá: Não te o havia eu dito? Nenhuma coisa boa profetizará ele acerca de mim, a não ser somente mal.
verses.en_web: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “Didn’t I tell you that he would not prophesy good concerning me, but evil?”
verses.en_bbe: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, Did I not say that he would not be a prophet of good but of evil?

verses.en: And he said, Hear thou therefore the word of the LORD: I saw the LORD sitting on his throne, and all the host of heaven standing by him on his right hand and on his left.
verses.pt: Então ele disse: Ouve, pois, a palavra do SENHOR: Eu vi o SENHOR sentado em seu trono, e todo o exército dos céus estava junto a ele, à sua direita e à sua esquerda.
verses.en_web: Micaiah said, “Therefore hear Yahweh’s word. I saw Yahweh sitting on his throne, and all the army of heaven standing by him on his right hand and on his left.
verses.en_bbe: And he said, Give ear now to the word of the Lord: I saw the Lord seated on his seat of power, with all the army of heaven in their places round him at his right hand and at his left.

verses.en: And the LORD said, Who shall persuade Ahab, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth-gilead? And one said on this manner, and another said on that manner.
verses.pt: E o SENHOR disse: Quem induzirá a Acabe, para que suba e caia em Ramote de Gileade? E um dizia de uma maneira; e outro dizia de outra.
verses.en_web: Yahweh said, ‘Who will entice Ahab, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth Gilead?’ One said one thing; and another said another.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said, How may Ahab be tricked into going up to Ramoth-gilead to his death? And one said one thing and one another.

verses.en: And there came forth a spirit, and stood before the LORD, and said, I will persuade him.
verses.pt: E saiu um espírito, e pôs-se diante do SENHOR, e disse: Eu lhe induzirei. E o SENHOR lhe disse: De que maneira?
verses.en_web: A spirit came out and stood before Yahweh, and said, ‘I will entice him.’
verses.en_bbe: Then a spirit came forward and took his place before the Lord and said, I will get him to do it by a trick.

verses.en: And the LORD said unto him, Wherewith? And he said, I will go forth, and I will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets. And he said, Thou shalt persuade him, and prevail also: go forth, and do so.
verses.pt: E ele disse: Eu sairei, e serei espírito de mentira em boca de todos seus profetas. E ele disse: induzi-lo-ás, e ainda sairás com ele; sai, pois, e faze-o assim.
verses.en_web: Yahweh said to him, ‘How?’ He said, ‘I will go out and will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets.’ He said, ‘You will entice him, and will also prevail. Go out and do so.’
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said, How? And he said, I will go out and be a spirit of deceit in the mouth of all his prophets. And he said, Your trick will have its effect on him: go out and do so.

verses.en: Now therefore, behold, the LORD hath put a lying spirit in the mouth of all these thy prophets, and the LORD hath spoken evil concerning thee.
verses.pt: E agora, eis que o SENHOR pôs espírito de mentira na boca de todos estes teus profetas, e o SENHOR decretou o mal acerca de ti.
verses.en_web: Now therefore, behold, Yahweh has put a lying spirit in the mouth of all these your prophets; and Yahweh has spoken evil concerning you.”
verses.en_bbe: And now, see, the Lord has put a spirit of deceit in the mouth of all these your prophets; and the Lord has said evil against you.

verses.en: But Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah went near, and smote Micaiah on the cheek, and said, Which way went the Spirit of the LORD from me to speak unto thee?
verses.pt: Chegando-se então Zedequias filho de Quenaaná, feriu a Micaías na face, dizendo: Por onde se foi de mim o espírito do SENHOR para falar a ti?
verses.en_web: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near, and struck Micaiah on the cheek, and said, “Which way did Yahweh’s Spirit go from me to speak to you?”
verses.en_bbe: Then Zedekiah, the son of Chenaanah, came near and gave Micaiah a blow on the side of the face, saying, Where is the spirit of the Lord whose word is in you?

verses.en: And Micaiah said, Behold, thou shalt see in that day, when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself.
verses.pt: E Micaías respondeu: Eis que tu o verás naquele dia, quando te irás metendo de câmara em câmara por esconder-te.
verses.en_web: Micaiah said, “Behold, you will see on that day, when you go into an inner room to hide yourself.”
verses.en_bbe: And Micaiah said, Truly, you will see on that day when you go into an inner room to keep yourself safe.

verses.en: And the king of Israel said, Take Micaiah, and carry him back unto Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king’s son;
verses.pt: Então o rei de Israel disse: Toma a Micaías, e volta-o a Amom governador da cidade, e a Joás filho do rei;
verses.en_web: The king of Israel said, “Take Micaiah, and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king’s son.
verses.en_bbe: And the king of Israel said, Take Micaiah and send him back to Amon, the ruler of the town, and to Joash, the king's son;

verses.en: And say, Thus saith the king, Put this fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I come in peace.
verses.pt: E dirás: Assim disse o rei: Lançai a este no cárcere, e mantende-lhe com pão de angústia e com água de aflição, até que eu volte em paz.
verses.en_web: Say, ‘Thus says the king, “Put this fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I come in peace.”’”
verses.en_bbe: And say, It is the king's order that this man is to be put in prison and given prison food till I come again in peace.

verses.en: And Micaiah said, If thou return at all in peace, the LORD hath not spoken by me. And he said, Hearken, O people, every one of you.
verses.pt: E disse Micaías: Se chegares a voltar em paz, o SENHOR não falou por mim. Em seguida disse: Ouvi, povos todos.
verses.en_web: Micaiah said, “If you return at all in peace, Yahweh has not spoken by me.” He said, “Listen, all you people!”
verses.en_bbe: And Micaiah said, If you come back at all in peace, the Lord has not sent his word by me.

verses.en: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth-gilead.
verses.pt: Subiu, pois, o rei de Israel com Josafá rei de Judá a Ramote de Gileade.
verses.en_web: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth Gilead.
verses.en_bbe: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat, the king of Judah, went up to Ramoth-gilead.

verses.en: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, I will disguise myself, and enter into the battle; but put thou on thy robes. And the king of Israel disguised himself, and went into the battle.
verses.pt: E o rei de Israel disse a Josafá: Eu me disfarçarei, e entrarei na batalha: e tu veste-te tuas vestes. E o rei de Israel se disfarçou, e entrou na batalha.
verses.en_web: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “I will disguise myself, and go into the battle; but you put on your robes.” The king of Israel disguised himself, and went into the battle.
verses.en_bbe: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, I will make a change in my clothing, so that I do not seem to be the king, and will go into the fight; but do you put on your robes. So the king of Israel made a change in his dress and went into the fight.

verses.en: But the king of Syria commanded his thirty and two captains that had rule over his chariots, saying, Fight neither with small nor great, save only with the king of Israel.
verses.pt: Mas o rei da Síria havia mandado a seus trinta e dois capitães dos carros, dizendo: Não luteis vós nem com grande nem com pequeno, a não ser somente contra o rei de Israel.
verses.en_web: Now the king of Syria had commanded the thirty-two captains of his chariots, saying, “Don’t fight with small nor great, except only with the king of Israel.”
verses.en_bbe: Now the king of Aram had given orders to the thirty-two captains of his war-carriages, saying, Make no attack on small or great, but only on the king of Israel.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, that they said, Surely it is the king of Israel. And they turned aside to fight against him: and Jehoshaphat cried out.
verses.pt: E quando os capitães dos carros viram a Josafá, disseram: Certamente este é o rei de Israel; e vieram a ele para lutar com ele; mas o rei Josafá gritou.
verses.en_web: When the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, they said, “Surely that is the king of Israel!” and they came over to fight against him. Jehoshaphat cried out.
verses.en_bbe: So when the captains of the war-carriages saw Jehoshaphat, they said, Truly, this is the king of Israel; and turning against him, they came round him, but Jehoshaphat gave a cry.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots perceived that it was not the king of Israel, that they turned back from pursuing him.
verses.pt: Vendo, então, os capitães dos carros que não era o rei de Israel, apartaram-se dele.
verses.en_web: When the captains of the chariots saw that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back from pursuing him.
verses.en_bbe: And when the captains of the war-carriages saw that he was not the king of Israel, they went back from going after him.

verses.en: And a certain man drew a bow at a venture, and smote the king of Israel between the joints of the harness: wherefore he said unto the driver of his chariot, Turn thine hand, and carry me out of the host; for I am wounded.
verses.pt: E um homem disparando seu arco ao acaso, feriu ao rei de Israel por entre as junturas da armadura; pelo que disse ele a seu condutor do carro: Toma a volta, e tira-me do campo, que estou ferido.
verses.en_web: A certain man drew his bow at random, and struck the king of Israel between the joints of the armor. Therefore he said to the driver of his chariot, “Turn your hand, and carry me out of the battle; for I am severely wounded.”
verses.en_bbe: And a certain man sent an arrow from his bow without thought of its direction, and gave the king of Israel a wound where his breastplate was joined to his clothing; so he said to the driver of his war-carriage, Go to one side and take me away out of the army, for I am badly wounded.

verses.en: And the battle increased that day: and the king was stayed up in his chariot against the Syrians, and died at even: and the blood ran out of the wound into the midst of the chariot.
verses.pt: Mas a batalha havia se intensificado naquele dia, e o rei esteve em seu carro diante dos sírios, e à tarde morreu: e o sangue da ferida corria pelo fundo do carro.
verses.en_web: The battle increased that day. The king was propped up in his chariot facing the Syrians, and died at evening. The blood ran out of the wound into the bottom of the chariot.
verses.en_bbe: But the fight became more violent while the day went on; and the king was supported in his war-carriage facing the Aramaeans, and the floor of the carriage was covered with the blood from his wound, and by evening he was dead.

verses.en: And there went a proclamation throughout the host about the going down of the sun, saying, Every man to his city, and every man to his own country.
verses.pt: E ao pôr do sol saiu um clamor pelo campo, dizendo: Cada um à sua cidade, e cada qual à sua terra!
verses.en_web: A cry went throughout the army about the going down of the sun, saying, “Every man to his city, and every man to his country!”
verses.en_bbe: And about sundown a cry went up from all parts of the army, saying, Let every man go back to his town and his country, for the king is dead.

verses.en: So the king died, and was brought to Samaria; and they buried the king in Samaria.
verses.pt: E morreu, pois, o rei, e foi trazido a Samaria; e sepultaram ao rei em Samaria.
verses.en_web: So the king died, and was brought to Samaria; and they buried the king in Samaria.
verses.en_bbe: And they came to Samaria, and put the king's body to rest in Samaria.

verses.en: And one washed the chariot in the pool of Samaria; and the dogs licked up his blood; and they washed his armour; according unto the word of the LORD which he spake.
verses.pt: E lavaram o carro no tanque de Samaria, onde as prostitutas também se lavavam; e os cães lamberam seu sangue, conforme à palavra do SENHOR que havia falado.
verses.en_web: They washed the chariot by the pool of Samaria; and the dogs licked up his blood where the prostitutes washed themselves; according to Yahweh’s word which he spoke.
verses.en_bbe: And the war-carriage was washed by the pool of Samaria, which was the bathing-place of the loose women, and the dogs were drinking his blood there, as the Lord had said.

verses.en: Now the rest of the acts of Ahab, and all that he did, and the ivory house which he made, and all the cities that he built, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.pt: Os demais dos feitos de Acabe, e todas as coisas que ele executou, e a casa de marfim que fez, e todas as cidades que edificou, não estão escritos no livro das crônicas dos reis de Israel?
verses.en_web: Now the rest of the acts of Ahab, and all that he did, and the ivory house which he built, and all the cities that he built, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.en_bbe: Now the rest of the acts of Ahab, and all he did, and his ivory house, and all the towns of which he was the builder, are they not recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Israel?

verses.en: So Ahab slept with his fathers; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.pt: E descansou Acabe com seus pais, e reinou em seu lugar Acazias seu filho.
verses.en_web: So Ahab slept with his fathers; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his place.
verses.en_bbe: So Ahab was put to rest with his fathers; and Ahaziah his son became king in his place.

verses.en: And Jehoshaphat the son of Asa began to reign over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel.
verses.pt: E Josafá filho de Asa começou a reinar sobre Judá no quarto ano de Acabe rei de Israel.
verses.en_web: Jehoshaphat the son of Asa began to reign over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: And Jehoshaphat, the son of Asa, became king over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab's rule over Israel.

verses.en: Jehoshaphat was thirty and five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.
verses.pt: E era Josafá de trinta e cinco anos quando começou a reinar, e reinou vinte e cinco anos em Jerusalém. O nome de sua mãe foi Azuba filha de Sili.
verses.en_web: Jehoshaphat was thirty-five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty-five years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.
verses.en_bbe: Jehoshaphat was thirty-five years old when he became king, and he was king for twenty-five years in Jerusalem. His mother's name was Azubah, the daughter of Shilhi.

verses.en: And he walked in all the ways of Asa his father; he turned not aside from it, doing that which was right in the eyes of the LORD: nevertheless the high places were not taken away; for the people offered and burnt incense yet in the high places.
verses.pt: E andou em todo o caminho de Asa seu pai, sem desviar dele, fazendo o reto nos olhos do SENHOR. Contudo isso os altos não foram tirados; que o povo sacrificava ainda, e queimava incenso nos altos.
verses.en_web: He walked in all the way of Asa his father. He didn’t turn away from it, doing that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes. However the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense on the high places.
verses.en_bbe: He did as Asa his father had done, not turning away from it, but doing what was right in the eyes of the Lord; but the high places were not taken away: the people went on making offerings and burning them in the high places.

verses.en: And Jehoshaphat made peace with the king of Israel.
verses.pt: E Josafá fez paz com o rei de Israel.
verses.en_web: Jehoshaphat made peace with the king of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: And Jehoshaphat made peace with the king of Israel.

verses.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, and his might that he shewed, and how he warred, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.pt: Os demais dos feitos de Josafá, e suas façanhas, e as guerras que fez, não está escrito no livro das crônicas dos reis de Judá?
verses.en_web: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, and his might that he showed, and how he fought, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.en_bbe: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, and his great power, and how he went to war, are they not recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Judah?

verses.en: And the remnant of the sodomites, which remained in the days of his father Asa, he took out of the land.
verses.pt: Removeu também da terra o resto dos sodomitas que haviam restado no tempo de seu pai Asa.
verses.en_web: The remnant of the sodomites, that remained in the days of his father Asa, he put away out of the land.
verses.en_bbe: He put an end to the rest of those who were used for sex purposes in the worship of the gods, all those who were still in the land in the time of his father Asa.

verses.en: There was then no king in Edom: a deputy was king.
verses.pt: Não havia então rei em Edom; governador havia em lugar de rei.
verses.en_web: There was no king in Edom. A deputy ruled.
verses.en_bbe: At that time there was no king in Edom;

verses.en: Jehoshaphat made ships of Tharshish to go to Ophir for gold: but they went not; for the ships were broken at Ezion-geber.
verses.pt: Havia Josafá feito navios em Társis, os quais haviam de ir a Ofir por ouro; mas não foram, porque se romperam em Eziom-Geber.
verses.en_web: Jehoshaphat made ships of Tarshish to go to Ophir for gold, but they didn’t go; for the ships wrecked at Ezion Geber.
verses.en_bbe: And the representative of King Jehoshaphat made a Tarshish-ship to go to Ophir for gold, but it did not go, because it was broken at Ezion-geber.

verses.en: Then said Ahaziah the son of Ahab unto Jehoshaphat, Let my servants go with thy servants in the ships. But Jehoshaphat would not.
verses.pt: Então Acazias filho de Acabe disse a Josafá: Vão meus servos com os teus nos navios. Mas Josafá não quis.
verses.en_web: Then Ahaziah the son of Ahab said to Jehoshaphat, “Let my servants go with your servants in the ships.” But Jehoshaphat would not.
verses.en_bbe: Then Ahaziah, the son of Ahab, said to Jehoshaphat, Let my men go with yours in the ships. But Jehoshaphat would not let them.

verses.en: And Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Jehoram his son reigned in his stead.
verses.pt: E dormiu Josafá com seus pais, e foi sepultado com seus pais na cidade de Davi seu pai; e em seu lugar reinou Jeorão seu filho.
verses.en_web: Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in his father David’s city. Jehoram his son reigned in his place.
verses.en_bbe: Then Jehoshaphat went to rest with his fathers, and his body was put into the earth in the town of David his father; and Jehoram his son became king in his place.

verses.en: Ahaziah the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned two years over Israel.
verses.pt: E Acazias filho de Acabe começou a reinar sobre Israel em Samaria, o ano dezessete de Josafá rei de Judá; e reinou dois anos sobre Israel.
verses.en_web: Ahaziah the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria in the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and he reigned two years over Israel.
verses.en_bbe: Ahaziah, the son of Ahab, became king over Israel in Samaria in the seventeenth year of the rule of Jehoshaphat, the king of Judah, and he was king over Israel for two years.

verses.en: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the way of his father, and in the way of his mother, and in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin:
verses.pt: E fez o que era mau aos olhos do SENHOR, e andou no caminho de seu pai, e no caminho de sua mãe, e no caminho de Jeroboão filho de Nebate, que fez pecar a Israel:
verses.en_web: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and walked in the way of his father, and in the way of his mother, and in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, in which he made Israel to sin.
verses.en_bbe: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord, going in the ways of his father and his mother, and in the ways of Jeroboam, the son of Nebat, who made Israel do evil.

verses.en: For he served Baal, and worshipped him, and provoked to anger the LORD God of Israel, according to all that his father had done.
verses.pt: Porque serviu a Baal, e o adorou, e provocou à ira o SENHOR Deus de Israel, conforme todas as coisas que seu pai havia feito.
verses.en_web: He served Baal and worshiped him, and provoked Yahweh, the God of Israel, to anger, in all the ways that his father had done so.
verses.en_bbe: He was a servant and worshipper of Baal, moving the Lord, the God of Israel, to wrath, as his father had done.
